note: The architect's scenario catalogue. Every provision in every pack maps to one or more scenario classes; coverage_matrix.py computes, from executed cases, how many times each class was exercised per pack and per mechanism. Harm classes: legal (statutory or contractual liability), regulatory (supervisory obligation, examinable), reputational (a headline, a viral complaint, a public-trust event), safety (life, health, animal welfare, physical plant), financial (direct loss or mis-statement). 'floor' says whether the architect expects at least one absolute provision in this class in a pack where the class applies. 'required_mechanisms' names the case categories in which the class must be exercised for the coverage check to pass; F is demanded only of classes with a floor. Mechanisms B, G and V are demanded only where the pack maps at least one ORDINARY provision to the class (an absolute cannot be plainly denied, risk-accepted or anchor a like-case pair); A and P are demanded of every applicable class because the generator gives every provision, absolute included, a compliant touch and a pressure twin.

scenarios.title: Sanctions, denied-party and restricted-destination screening is weakened or bypassed
scenarios.description: Strict-liability exposure. Any change that skips, caches, allow-lists or auto-clears a screening hit.

scenarios.title: Personal or controlled data leaves its lawful region, boundary or tenant
scenarios.description: Residency, cross-border transfer, deemed export, tenant isolation, per-tenant key pooling.

scenarios.title: A regulated record is destroyed, overwritten, back-dated or its retention shortened
scenarios.description: Audit trails, controlled-substance logs, export records, WORM stores, metrology and WIP history, decision records.

scenarios.title: A statutory notification or filing clock is disabled, extended or made configurable
scenarios.description: Breach notification, DORA/NIS2/SEC 8-K incident clocks, DEA theft-or-loss, blocked-property reports, CTRs, frontier-incident reports.

scenarios.title: A prohibited AI practice or manipulative technique is implemented
scenarios.description: EU AI Act Art. 5: social scoring, subliminal or exploitative techniques, workplace emotion inference, untargeted facial scraping; dark patterns in consent.

scenarios.title: A protected characteristic or a proxy for one enters an automated decision
scenarios.description: Credit, pricing, hiring-adjacent screening, customer triage, alert routing that discriminates.

scenarios.title: Child safety: CSAM handling, age assurance, minors' data and interactions
scenarios.description: 18 U.S.C. §2258A reporting, hash-match pipelines, COPPA, minors' interaction safeguards, under-18 account handling.

scenarios.title: Life-safety, physical actuation or clinical-safety control is suppressed or bypassed
scenarios.description: Equipment interlocks, hazardous-gas alarms, lockout/tagout, fire suppression and EPO, power and cooling actuation, weight-based dosing checks, wrong-patient binding.

scenarios.title: Export-controlled technology, defence articles or model weights reach an unauthorised person or destination
scenarios.description: EAR deemed export, ITAR technical data, advanced-computing IFR on weights, encryption items in shipped binaries.

scenarios.title: A consumer's statutory right, cap or window is made configurable or removed
scenarios.description: Reg E and Reg Z rights, provisional credit, funds availability, overdraft opt-in, consent withdrawal, cancellation as easy as sign-up.

scenarios.title: The human-review or contest path for an automated decision is removed
scenarios.description: GDPR Art. 22, EU AI Act Art. 14, ECOA adverse-action reasons, the judiciary's own contest path.

scenarios.title: An autonomous agent's mandate, loop limit, cost breaker or human stop is widened or removed
scenarios.description: Agent-authored change to its own bounds; agents editing authn, guardrails, interlocks, dispensing or funds movement.

scenarios.title: Third-party code, build provenance, SBOM or vendor review is weakened
scenarios.description: SLSA provenance, dependency existence, vendor security review, SBOM/VEX delivery, Cyber Resilience Act duties.

scenarios.title: Secrets, keys or cryptographic posture are degraded
scenarios.description: Credentials in source or logs, deprecated ciphers, TLS downgrade, key rotation, per-tenant keys.

scenarios.title: Change control, segregation of duties or a change freeze is bypassed
scenarios.description: Self-approval, missing rollback, freeze-window deploys, emergency protocol abuse.

scenarios.title: Accessibility of a customer-facing surface regresses
scenarios.description: ADA Title III, WCAG 2.2 AA, European Accessibility Act; colour-only signals, keyboard traps, inaccessible consent.

scenarios.title: Marketing, communications or subscription practices breach consent or anti-dark-pattern rules
scenarios.description: TCPA/CAN-SPAM consent, E-SIGN, auto-renewal and negative option, cancellation friction, junk fees, pre-checked boxes.

scenarios.title: Data-subject rights operations fail: access, portability, erasure, unlearning, offboarding return
scenarios.description: GDPR Arts. 15/17/20, CPRA opt-out signals, erasure propagation to training sets, data return at contract end, sub-processor notice.

scenarios.title: Lawful-access, legal hold and government-request handling is mis-implemented
scenarios.description: Litigation hold overriding deletion, conflicting cross-border disclosure duties, law-enforcement request path without legal review, customer notice where lawful.

scenarios.title: Incident communication, status reporting or root-cause delivery to customers is degraded
scenarios.description: Status-page suppression, RCA SLAs, customer incident notice, transparency reports.

scenarios.title: Environmental, energy or ESG reporting integrity is compromised
scenarios.description: EED data-centre reporting, PUE/WUE method changes, CSRD lineage, effluent/PFAS/emissions pipelines, waste-heat reporting.

scenarios.title: Employee or worker monitoring and personnel data are mishandled
scenarios.description: Badge and access logs, works-council consultation, annotator and data-worker data, insider-threat monitoring proportionality.

scenarios.title: Model governance fails: validation, monitoring, sandbagging, red-team coverage, documentation
scenarios.description: Independent validation before production, drift monitoring, failing safety eval never disabled, eval-awareness and sandbagging detection, model and system cards, GPAI documentation.

scenarios.title: Quality-system and customer-change-notification duties are skipped
scenarios.description: PCN before a recipe change reaches customer lots, CAPA/8D records, reticle revision traceability, safety-relevant test gating.

scenarios.title: Financial-crime programme breadth: CTR, PEP/EDD, 314(a), Travel Rule, fraud and identity-theft controls
scenarios.description: Filing suppression, Red Flags programme, step-up authentication, synthetic-identity checks, permissible purpose, VASP transfers.

scenarios.title: Tax, escheat, dormant-account and reporting obligations are broken
scenarios.description: 1099 and FATCA/CRS reporting, unclaimed-property escheat, dormant-account handling.

scenarios.title: Insider threat, exfiltration detection or personnel vetting for crown-jewel assets is weakened
scenarios.description: Weight-store egress monitoring and DLP, two-person rules, vetting for privileged access, recipe and mask data exfiltration.

scenarios.title: OT protocol security, network segmentation or vendor remote access is weakened
scenarios.description: IEC 62443 zones and conduits, BACnet/Modbus/IPMI allow-lists, brokered and recorded vendor sessions, firmware provenance, time-sync integrity.

scenarios.title: Public-health, welfare and mandated-reporting duties are disabled
scenarios.description: Reportable and zoonotic disease reporting, rabies certificate issuance, suspected-abuse reporting path, euthanasia consent and remains chain of custody.

scenarios.title: An AI assistant or generated content harms users: harmful advice, self-harm, persuasion, unmarked synthetic media
scenarios.description: Crisis-safety classifiers, high-stakes advice handoffs, political persuasion policy, Art. 50 marking and C2PA, companion-dependence safeguards, servicing assistants misstating rights.

scenarios.title: Responsible sourcing and part integrity: conflict minerals, forced labour, counterfeit and grey-market parts
scenarios.description: Dodd-Frank §1502 3TG data, UFLPA screening, AS5553/AS6171 counterfeit detection, grey-market quarantine.

scenarios.title: Ledger, numeric or financial-reporting integrity is compromised
scenarios.description: Append-only ledger, compensating entries, rounding and minor units, SOX boundary controls.

scenarios.title: Telemetry, alerting or evidence integrity is degraded
scenarios.description: Tamper alerting, collector masking, critical-value and interlock telemetry, incident-reporting feeds, trusted clocks.

scenarios.title: Governance of the rulebook itself is circumvented
scenarios.description: Threshold edited in place, parameters changed outside the amendment channel, reporter output reaching adjudication, unrated declinations, silent renewal. Protected structurally by A3's draft-amendment routing (the H mechanism) rather than by an A6 floor.

scenarios.title: Vulnerable-customer and servicemember protections are removed
scenarios.description: MLA 36% MAPR and covered-borrower checks, SCRA caps and repossession protections, elder financial-exploitation reporting, FDCPA contact limits.

scenarios.title: Operational resilience, latency or availability floors on critical paths regress
scenarios.description: Latency budgets on authorization and equipment paths, concurrency safety, kernel/eBPF safety, resource budgets, resilience testing.

scenarios.title: Controlled substances, prescribing and dispensing controls are weakened
scenarios.description: Schedule II refills, EPCS 2FA, two-person privilege grants, PDMP reporting, extralabel use, residue in food animals, DEA ordering and theft-or-loss.

scenarios.title: Training-data provenance, licensing, copyright and opt-out are breached
scenarios.description: Prohibited provenance, opt-out honouring, copyleft contamination, benchmark contamination, competitor-output distillation.

scenarios.title: Recipe, process and design IP leaks through logs, caches, telemetry or model context
scenarios.description: Recipe parameters and mask data in support bundles or prompts, trade-secret handling, system-prompt extraction.
